question: Where can I get the available grid connection capacity per substation or node in Germany, for generation and for demand, with the latest value and its history?

answer.summary: Germany has no unified official substation hosting-capacity dataset across its 4 TSOs and ~865 electricity DSOs (inferred by subtracting 4 TSOs from 869 active Stromnetzbetreiber in BNetzA's MaStR). At TSO level, 50Hertz exposes a JSON API for 75 substations with available, reserved and requested MW for generation and demand (and an undocumented-unit constructionCostContribution field); TransnetBW embeds 52 substations in HTML with MW bands; Amprion and TenneT list 10 substations each without available MW. At DSO level, Geoportal Saarland maps renewable feed-in MW for 6 DSOs and E.ON DSOs publish qualitative maps (HTTP 403). Only paid aggregator GridChecker (844 sites) keeps history.
main_caveats: No single national official portal exists: publication is split across 4 TSOs and ~865 electricity DSOs, and VNBdigital (814 DSOs) only hosts territories, Netzausbaupläne and portal links.
Since 1 April 2026 all 4 TSOs allocate large load and battery connections via cyclic Reifegradverfahren (first-ready, first-served); published MW values are non-binding maximum indications.
Only 50Hertz (exact MW) and TransnetBW (MW bands for 2032/2035) publish node-level generation and demand MW at TSO level; Amprion and TenneT publish bay/site availability without MW.
Saarland Geoportal and Netze BW's Mittelspannungsauskunft cover generation feed-in only; urban DSO Repartition/Fair-Grid notices (Hamburg, Düsseldorf, Berlin) give only grid-wide MVA totals.
50Hertz's JSON API sets available*CapacityMw to null (not 0) on 60/75 unavailable nodes and duplicates Eulenberg (EUB) and Eulenberg (EUB) Neubau with identical 1,800/2,000 MW values.
Official portals overwrite snapshots in place with no history; TenneT and E.ON DSO portals (Bayernwerk, E.DIS, SH Netz, Westnetz) block non-browser HTTP clients via Cloudflare HTTP 403.
answer.confidence_reason: All 4 TSOs, BNetzA, SMARD, VNBdigital (814 DSOs), EnWG/BMWE's 2026 Netzanschlusspaket bill, Capacitypedia, Saarland Geoportal, 18 major DSOs and GridChecker were directly inspected.

attributes.note: 50Hertz (75 EHV nodes), TransnetBW (52), Amprion (10), TenneT (10) and ~25 DSOs publish substation entries; 8 of 18 directly tested DSOs publish none or only grid-wide totals.
attributes.gap_note: Among tested operators, 8 of 18 DSOs publish no per-substation capacity (BMWE's August 2026 § 17c EnWG-E bill remains in parliament; VNBdigital's 814 DSO profiles expose only territories, Netzausbaupläne and portal links), Amprion and TenneT omit unavailable substations from their tables, TenneT and 7 regional DSO portals return HTTP 403, GridChecker's full 844-site table is paid, and ~841 smaller DSOs were not individually opened.

attributes.note: 50Hertz gives exact firm MW per EHV node (13/75 >0 MW); TransnetBW gives MW bands (2032/2035); Saarland Geoportal gives HV/MV renewable MW; Netze BW/N-ERGIE check <=10 MW.
attributes.gap_note: Among tested operators, Amprion and TenneT publish no numerical generation MW per substation, E.ON regional DSO maps (Bayernwerk, E.DIS, SH Netz) use qualitative classes behind Cloudflare HTTP 403, tested urban/regional DSOs (8 of 18) publish only network-wide MVA or none, GridChecker's consolidated export is paid, and ~841 smaller electricity DSOs were not individually checked.

attributes.note: 50Hertz gives availableLoadCapacityMw (15/75 >0 MW) and TransnetBW gives load MW bands; N-ERGIE Netz offers single-site LV/MV pre-checks <=10 MW; GridChecker tracks 844 sites.
attributes.gap_note: Amprion and TenneT publish qualitative bay/site availability without numerical demand MW; Geoportal Saarland and Netze BW's Mittelspannungsauskunft cover generation feed-in only; tested urban DSOs (Hamburger Energienetze 0 MVA, Düsseldorf 0 MVA, ENERVIE ~100 MVA, Stromnetz Berlin suspended) publish only grid-wide totals; 7 regional DSO portals returned HTTP 403, GridChecker is paid, and ~841 smaller DSOs were not individually checked.

attributes.note: Latest snapshots: 50Hertz knowledge 2026-03-31 (API updatedAt 2026-05-18), TransnetBW 2026-04-01 (map 05/2026), Amprion 04/2026, Saarland WMS 2026-11-24, GridChecker 2026-11-25.
attributes.gap_note: Among tested sources, current node-level generation and demand MW exist only at 50Hertz and TransnetBW (with 6–8 month assessment lag), Saarland (feed-in only), single-site MV pre-check tools, and paid GridChecker; Westnetz's 110 kV grid-group PDF dates from 2022-07-01, 7 DSO portals returned HTTP 403, 8 tested DSOs publish no node snapshot, and ~841 smaller DSOs were not individually checked.

attributes.note: No tested official German TSO or DSO portal archives past hosting-capacity snapshots; commercial aggregator GridChecker archives daily snapshots for 29 operators since Oct 2024.
attributes.gap_note: All tested official TSO and DSO portals overwrite their current map or PDF snapshot in place without historical archives. GridChecker retains versioned daily snapshots since October 2024 (e.g. 22 snapshots for TenneT DE since 2026-06-09, 1 for Bayernwerk since 2026-11-16), but requires a paid commercial plan and covers 29 operators; 7 regional DSO portals returned HTTP 403 and ~841 smaller DSOs were not individually checked.

attributes.note: 50Hertz and TransnetBW update ad hoc/cyclically; TenneT every ~10 months; Netze BW weekly; urban DSO Repartition portals annually; GridChecker polls daily at 05:15 UTC.
attributes.gap_note: Although Art. 50(4a) of Regulation (EU) 2019/943 requires monthly TSO updates and Art. 31(3) of Directive (EU) 2019/944 requires at least quarterly DSO updates (transposed as monthly in pending § 17c(1) EnWG-E), tested German operators mostly state ad-hoc or 10-to-12-month cycle updates (Saarland WMS states no schedule), 7 DSO portals returned HTTP 403, and ~841 smaller DSOs were not individually checked.

unit.quote: Verfügbare Einspeisekapazität: 1.000 – 1.500 MW Verfügbare Lastkapazität: 1.000 – 1.500 MW

inclusion_rule.value: Extra-high-voltage (380 kV and 220 kV) substations evaluated for firm connection capacity considering existing connected units, reservations, switchgear bay availability/expandability, and the 3 GW busbar criterion; Amprion's table and TenneT's map/table list only substations with potential future availability.
inclusion_rule.quote: Die Bewertung basiert auf vorhandenen beziehungsweise konkret geplanten Schaltfeldern und neu geplanten Umspannwerken unter Berücksichtigung der Netzauslastung und weiterer technischer Restriktionen.

reference_date.value: 50Hertz: 2026-03-31 state of knowledge (JSON locations updatedAt up to 2026-05-18); TransnetBW: 2026-04-01 assessment (map Stand 05/2026, horizons 2032 and 2035); Amprion: April 2026 (horizons 2032–2035); TenneT: horizons 2030–2036.
reference_date.quote: Die auf der Netzkarte dargestellten Netzanschlusspunkte basieren auf der zum 31.03.2026 bestmöglichen Einschätzung und Kenntnislage von 50Hertz.

update_frequency.value: Cyclic / ad hoc aligned with TSO Reifegradverfahren cycles (50Hertz: continuous/when needed; TransnetBW: cyclic; Amprion: static April 2026 edition; TenneT: every ~10 months per Capacitypedia).
update_frequency.quote: Die Karte wird zyklisch aktualisiert. Neu verfügbare Netzanschlusspunkte, die sich im Rahmen des Netzausbaus ergeben, werden rechtzeitig in der Karte veröffentlicht.

exclusions.value: 110 kV and medium/low-voltage distribution substations are excluded; line tap connections outside substations require individual assessment; TransnetBW's UI hides 37 red (unavailable) substations by default via JavaScript; Amprion and TenneT do not publish numerical MW.
exclusions.quote: Anfragen abseits von bestehenden bzw. ausgewiesenen Umspannwerken sollen grundsätzlich nicht im Rahmen des Reifegradverfahrens gestellt werden.

key_fields.meaning: 50Hertz substation name (with short code, e.g. 'Altentreptow Süd (ATS)') and WGS84 longitude (x) and latitude (y) as strings.
50Hertz maximum indicative available generation (feed-in) and demand (load) connection capacity in MW (null when unavailable).
50Hertz already reserved generation and load connection capacity in MW per substation.
50Hertz pending requested generation and load connection capacity in MW per substation.
50Hertz count of available switchgear bays, EHV voltage ('380', '220', '380/220'), and downstream regional DSO name.
TransnetBW substation status (green 2032, yellow 2035, red unavailable), n-0/n-1 class and MW bands; Amprion 380 kV substation, municipality, bay class and earliest commissioning year.

steps: 50Hertz (75 EHV substations): GET the GetDnbInfo JSON endpoint above and iterate over data['locations']; parse float(coordinate['x']) as WGS84 longitude and float(coordinate['y']) as latitude.

TransnetBW (52 EHV substations): GET https://www.transnetbw.de/de/transparenz/netzzugang-und-entgelt/netzanschlusskarte and parse all HTML elements matching div.tooltip; extract the colour class (tooltip-uw-type--green, --yellow, --red) and text lines for Spannungsebene, Inbetriebnahme Netzanschluss, Anschlussart, Verfügbare Einspeisekapazität and Verfügbare Lastkapazität.

Amprion (10 available 380 kV substations): Download https://www.amprion.net/Dokumente/Strommarkt/Netzkunden/Netzanschlussregeln/07_Darstellung-der-Kundenprojekte-sowie-der-Schaltfeldverfuegbarkeit/Ergaenzendes-Dokument-zu-potenziellen-Netzanschlussmoeglichkeiten-04.2026.pdf and run pdftotext -layout to parse the 10-row table (Schaltanlage, Spannungsebene, Stadt/Gemeinde, Anschlussauslegung, Voraussichtlich frühestes Inbetriebnahmejahr, Anmerkungen).

TenneT Germany (10 future sites): Open https://www.tennet.eu/de/strommarkt/kunden-deutschland/netzanschlussanfragen in an interactive browser (plain HTTP clients receive Cloudflare HTTP 403) to view the map and table for 2030–2036.
reading_traps: In 50Hertz's JSON, availableGenerationCapacityMw and availableLoadCapacityMw are null (not 0.0) for 60 of 75 substations; only 15 substations have non-null values (13 > 0 MW and 2 equal to 0.0 MW for generation; 15 > 0 MW for load).

50Hertz's 75 rows include three same-coordinate pairs: ('Eulenberg (EUB)', 'Eulenberg (EUB) Neubau'), ('Güstrow (GUE)', 'Güstrow (GUES)') and ('Bärwalde (BAE)', 'Bärwalde (BAE) Schaltanlage'). Both Eulenberg rows report 1,800 MW available generation and 2,000 MW available load, so summing across rows without deduplicating double-counts Eulenberg.

50Hertz's Hohenwarte II (HOH2) Schaltanlage reports availableSwitchgearBay: 0 alongside 2,040 MW available generation and load (updatedAt: null), whereas Graustein (GRS) reports 5 available bays, 1,900 MW load and 0 MW generation.
50Hertz's JSON includes constructionCostContribution (values 40.0, 60.0, 100.0) with no unit in the schema (likely % Baukostenzuschuss tier).

TransnetBW's script (commented 'Update 2026/05: Hide all red UW from the map by default!') hides 37 red ('nicht verfügbar') substations in the browser, leaving only 9 green and 6 yellow markers visible unless you parse the underlying HTML .tooltip nodes; TransnetBW values apply only to future commissioning from 2032 (green) or 2035 (yellow), and Mannheim Süd explicitly notes '(keine BESS!)'.

Amprion's supplementary PDF lists only the 10 green substations ('Anschluss voraussichtlich realisierbar') without MW values; Clusorth and Meppen allow load connections only ('Es sind ausschließlich Lastanschlüsse möglich'), while Herringhausen, Kötz and Rieselfeld allow only reduced-output feed-in.

problems: TenneT Germany's page (https://www.tennet.eu/de/strommarkt/kunden-deutschland/netzanschlussanfragen) rejects automated HTTP clients with HTTP 403 (Cloudflare anti-bot challenge).
No historical snapshots are exposed by any of the four TSO portals.

evidence.claim: 50Hertz states that published available connection capacities are indicative maximum values as of 31 March 2026 with no legal entitlement.
evidence.quote: Bei den angegebenen Werten der verfügbaren Anschlussleistung handelt es sich um Maximalwerte - die genaue Kapazität kann erst ermittelt werden, wenn die genaue Zusammensetzung aller Anschlussnehmer und ihre Verortung bekannt ist. Die auf der Netzkarte dargestellten Netzanschlusspunkte basieren auf der zum 31.03.2026 bestmöglichen Einschätzung und Kenntnislage von 50Hertz.

evidence.claim: TransnetBW publishes substation-level connection perspectives based on knowledge as of 1 April 2026 (map Stand 05/2026) and updates cyclically.
evidence.quote: Die auf der Netzkarte dargestellten Netzanschlusspunkte und die verfügbaren Netzanschlusskapazitäten basieren auf der zum 01. April 2026 bestmöglichen Einschätzung und Kenntnislage.

evidence.claim: Amprion publishes static April 2026 PDF maps and a 10-substation supplementary document classifying switchgear stations into green ('Anschluss voraussichtlich realisierbar') and red ('Anschlussmöglichkeit nicht gegeben').
evidence.quote: Hierbei werden zwei Kategorien ausgewiesen: „Anschluss voraussichtlich realisierbar“ (grün), und „Anschlussmöglichkeit nicht gegeben“ (rot). Das ergänzende Dokument enthält weitere Informationen über die grün ausgewiesenen Schaltanlagen.

evidence.claim: ENTSO-E / EU DSO Entity Capacitypedia documents TenneT TSO Germany's publication as a map and table of substations with available future connection capacity (2030–2036) for demand and storage, updated every 10 months.
evidence.quote: Only substations with available (future) connection capacity are shown. Operator voltage level scope 220 kV, 380 kV Timeline for which HC is provided Potential commissioning years: 2030 - 2036 Information format Map and Table Categories of grid users considered Demand and storage

sources.name: Geoportal Saarland – Kapazitäten der Umspannanlagen
sources.publisher: Landesamt für Vermessung, Geoinformation und Landentwicklung Saarland (Zentrale Stelle GDI-SL) / Ministerium für Wirtschaft, Innovation, Digitales und Energie Saarland
sources.format: Mapbender web viewer / OGC WMS (linked per-substation graphics)
sources.license: Viewing free within Geoportal Saarland; any other use or embedding in external applications is expressly prohibited
sources.adds: Only official state-level geoportal in Germany consolidating numerical per-substation HV/MV renewable generation hosting capacity (MW) across multiple distribution system operators (6 Saarland/Pfalz DSOs).
sources.summary: Official Saarland state geoportal mapping HV/MV substations across 6 regional DSOs (VSE Verteilnetz, Creos Deutschland, Pfalzwerke Netz, Stadtwerke Saarbrücken Netz, SSW Netz, KEW) with linked graphics showing installed transformer MW, existing/committed EEG MW, arithmetic available feed-in MW, and queued MW.
sources.coverage_note: Covers Saarland and adjacent Pfalzwerke/Creos HV/MV substations (WMS Capabilities returns layer metadata without a feature count; 1 state out of 16 Länder).
caveats: Covers renewable generation feed-in only; no demand capacity is published.
'Verfügbar' is an arithmetic residual (Trafoleistung minus Bestand and Geplant), not a power-flow limit.
Terms forbid any use or embedding outside viewing in Geoportal Saarland.

coverage.geographic: Saarland (and adjacent Pfalzwerke/Creos substations; bbox 6.3088, 49.0375 to 7.5065, 49.7038), consolidating HV/MV substations of VSE Verteilnetz GmbH, Creos Deutschland GmbH, Pfalzwerke Netz AG, Stadtwerke Saarbrücken Netz AG, SSW Netz GmbH and KEW AG Neunkirchen.

unit.quote: Erläuterungen zu den Begrifflichkeiten auf den verlinkten Grafiken: Angaben zur Leistung in Megawatt (MW)

inclusion_rule.value: High-to-medium-voltage substations (Umspannanlagen) relevant for connecting larger EEG renewable generation plants in Saarland.
inclusion_rule.quote: Wichtig für Planungsvorhaben größerer EEG-Anlagen und deren räumlicher Anbindung sind Angaben zu den noch verfügbaren Einspeisekapazitäten bei den großen Netzknoten, den Umspannanlagen.

attempts.note: Describes figures as 'aktuelle Informationen' without stating a fixed update interval.
Shows timestamp 'Aktualität 2026-11-24 07:29:05' ('Letzte Aktualisierung 1 Tage') but no scheduled cadence.

exclusions.value: Covers renewable generation feed-in (Einspeisekapazität) only; demand/load hosting capacity is excluded, and 'Verfügbar' is a purely arithmetic transformer residual (Trafoleistung minus Bestand and Geplant) ignoring upstream TSO or feeder voltage constraints.
exclusions.quote: Bei dieser Angabe handelt es sich um einen Rechenwert, der die Differenz zwischen der „Trafoleistung“ als maximal möglicher Einspeiseleistung und dem „Bestand“ einschließlich „Geplant“ angibt.

key_fields.meaning: Total installed HV/MV transformer rating of the substation in MW.
Currently installed renewable capacity (MW) and bindingly committed/under-construction renewable capacity (MW) in the substation supply area.
Arithmetic remaining renewable feed-in capacity in MW (Trafoleistung minus Bestand and Geplant; negative values indicate grid expansion need).
Requested renewable feed-in capacity in MW not yet at 'Geplant' commitment stage.

how_to_use.example_result: <WMT_MS_Capabilities updateSequence="1795501745" version="1.1.1"><Service><Name>OGC:WMS</Name><Title>Kapazitäten Umspannanlagen SL</Title><Abstract>Der Kartendienst (WMS-Gruppe) stellt die digitalen Geodaten zu den Kapazitäten der Umspannanlagen im Saarland dar.</Abstract>
steps: Open https://geoportal.saarland.de/article/Umspannanlagen_Kapazitaeten/ and launch the Mapbender viewer (WMC=7400) for interactive inspection within Geoportal Saarland.
Click any HV/MV substation symbol to open the operator attribution and linked capacity graphic displaying Trafoleistung, Bestand, Geplant, Verfügbar and Anfragen in MW.
Respect the AccessConstraints in the WMS Capabilities document, which prohibit external embedding or reuse outside viewing in Geoportal Saarland.
reading_traps: 'Verfügbar' is calculated strictly as Trafoleistung − (Bestand + Geplant) in MW without N-1 contingency, thermal line or upstream network modelling, and can be < 0 MW.
Demand/load connection capacity is not reported at all.

Direct ArcGIS REST querying (/arcgis/rest/services/Internet/Netzbetreiber/MapServer) returns a 404 HTML page; only the Mapbender viewer and WMS Capabilities are exposed, under a strict viewer-only reuse prohibition.

problems: Terms of use prohibit any utilization beyond free viewing inside Geoportal Saarland.

Underlying ArcGIS REST MapServer endpoint is not publicly exposed (returns HTML 404), so substation count is not returned by WMS Capabilities (GridChecker indexes ~70+ Saarland/Pfalz substations from these operators).

evidence.claim: Saarland's grid operators jointly publish HV/MV substation locations and linked MW capacity graphics in Geoportal Saarland.
evidence.quote: Die saarländischen Netzbetreiber unterstützen diesen Prozess aktiv und haben aktuelle Informationen im Geoportal des Saarlandes zur Verfügung gestellt. Jede in Frage kommende Umspannanlage ist dort verortet.

evidence.claim: Geoportal Saarland prohibits any reuse or embedding outside viewing in the portal.
evidence.quote: Das Betrachten des Dienstes im “Geoportal Saarland“ ist kostenfrei. Jegliche andere Nutzung, so auch das Einbinden in andere Anwendungen ist untersagt.

how_to_use.example_result: Identify the local DSO for any German postal code or coordinate via VNBdigital's GraphQL API, then open that DSO's Netzanschluss / Online-Netzauskunft / Zuteilungsverfahren portal.
steps: Query VNBdigital (https://www.vnbdigital.de) by postal code, municipality or coordinate to identify the responsible electricity DSO among Germany's ~865 DSOs.

For Netze BW (Mittelspannungsauskunft, 156–10,000 kW feed-in), N-ERGIE Netz (Netzanschlussmonitor, <= 10 MW feed-in or load), EWE NETZ (Online-Netzauskunft Mittelspannung) or MITNETZ STROM (NiNa <= 135 kW / SNAP >= 135 kW), enter a candidate coordinate and MW in the web tool to obtain the nearest feasible MV connection point.

For Bayernwerk Netz, E.DIS Netz and Schleswig-Holstein Netz, open their *.zuteilungsverfahren.de portals in a browser (plain HTTP clients receive Cloudflare HTTP 403) to view qualitative HV/MV substation availability.
reading_traps: Do not confuse network-wide Repartition/Fair-Grid quotas (e.g. Hamburger Energienetze 0 MVA for 2026/2027, Netzgesellschaft Düsseldorf 0 MVA for 2026, ENERVIE Vernetzt ~100 MVA as of 10/2025) with substation-level hosting capacity; Stromnetz Berlin cancelled its planned April 2026 geographic capacity publication pending OLG Düsseldorf case VI-5 Kart 4/26 [V].
Do not confuse § 23c(1) Nr. 2 EnWG Netzstrukturdaten (e.g. SWM Infrastruktur's 3,522,500 kVA HV/MV installed transformer rating) with available connection capacity.

EWE NETZ's Online-Netzauskunft reports distance to the nearest MV line or substation without guaranteeing available MW; Netze BW's Mittelspannungsauskunft covers feed-in only and ignores TSO constraints.

E.ON's former joint municipal/substation portal netzampel.energy returns only a retired 628-byte shell page; current *.zuteilungsverfahren.de and corporate E.ON/Westnetz domains block non-browser HTTP clients with HTTP 403.

problems: No bulk substation download or public REST/WFS endpoint found on tested open DSO pages; interactive MV tools require per-coordinate queries.
Bayernwerk Netz, E.DIS Netz, Schleswig-Holstein Netz, Avacon Netz, Westnetz, Syna and Westfalen Weser Netz reject automated HTTP clients with HTTP 403 (Cloudflare/WAF).

evidence.claim: N-ERGIE Netz provides an online pre-check of free LV/MV connection capacities up to 10 MW for both generation and demand plants.
evidence.quote: Sie möchten sich unverbindlich ein erstes Bild machen, ob Ihre geplante Erzeugungs- oder Verbrauchsanlage an unser Nieder- oder Mittelspannungsnetz angebunden werden kann und ggf. verschiedene Standorte und Leistungen ausprobieren? Unsere Anwendung liefert den nächstmöglichen Anschlusspunkt, der Ihre geplante Leistung mit hoher Wahrscheinlichkeit aufnehmen kann.

evidence.claim: Hamburger Energienetze reports 0 MVA of firm or flexible MV/HV demand connection capacity outside local public-service projects in its first Fair Grid cycle (02.11.2026–30.09.2027).
evidence.quote: Darüber hinaus werden im ersten Zyklus keine Anschlusskapazitäten (0 MVA für feste Kapazitäten / 0 MVA für flexible Kapazitäten) in der Mittel- und Hochspannung vergeben.

evidence.claim: Stromnetz Berlin suspended its planned April 2026 publication of available capacities and their geographical locations pending OLG Düsseldorf proceedings (VI-5 Kart 4/26 [V]).
evidence.quote: We are no longer, as originally planned, going to publish the capacities for connection services currently available and/or available in the foreseeable future in our network area and their geographical location by the fifteenth working day in April 2026.

sources.name: GridChecker – Germany Grid Connection Capacity and Connection Queue

sources.license: Commercial proprietary (figures non-binding as published by grid operators)
sources.adds: Consolidates 844 substations across 29 German operators (all 4 TSOs and 25 DSOs) into one schema and is the only source retaining daily historical snapshots since October 2024.
sources.summary: Commercial aggregator harmonising public capacity maps and tables from 29 German operators (all 4 TSOs and 25 DSOs, 844 sites total), offering free HTML previews and paid CSV/API access with daily archived snapshots since October 2024.
sources.coverage_note: 844 records represent published substations and 17 Westnetz 110 kV grid groups across 29 operators (~3.3% of Germany's 869 active electricity grid operators); 815 have map coordinates.
caveats: Full CSV export and historical snapshots since Oct 2024 require a paid subscription.
Inherits upstream gaps (no numeric MW for Bayernwerk, Amprion or TenneT; includes 50Hertz Eulenberg duplicate and 2022 Westnetz PDF).

regulator.name: Bundesnetzagentur für Elektrizität, Gas, Telekommunikation, Post und Eisenbahnen (BNetzA)

operators.note: 4 balancing-responsible transmission system operators (Übertragungsnetzbetreiber: 50Hertz, Amprion, TenneT Germany, TransnetBW) and ~865 electricity distribution system operators (869 active Stromnetzbetreiber in BNetzA's live MaStR directory minus 4 TSOs; BMWE's Aug 2026 Netzanschlusspaket bill cites 866 DSOs on p. 41 / 851 on p. 25, and VNBdigital lists 814 electricity DSOs, 84 with 110 kV HV networks).

publication_obligation.norm: Directly applicable Art. 50(4a) subpara. 1 of Regulation (EU) 2019/943 (inserted by Regulation (EU) 2024/1747) for TSOs; Art. 31(3) subpara. 1 of Directive (EU) 2019/944 (inserted by Directive (EU) 2024/1711) for DSOs, pending national transposition in § 17c EnWG-E of the federal cabinet's Netzanschlusspaket bill (29 July / 12 August 2026; currently § 17c EnWG is repealed).
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: Clear information on capacity available for new connections with high spatial granularity, including capacity under connection request, criteria for calculation, and flexible connection possibilities; pending § 17c(1) EnWG-E requires EHV/HV and HV/MV geographic capacity maps for both feed-in and load on each operator's website (plus MV online pre-check tools from 1 January 2028 under § 17c(2) EnWG-E).
publication_obligation.frequency: At least monthly for TSOs under Art. 50(4a) Regulation (EU) 2019/943; at least quarterly for DSOs under Art. 31(3) Directive (EU) 2019/944, tightened to monthly for EHV/HV and HV/MV maps in draft § 17c(1) EnWG-E.

consolidated_republication.note: Neither EU Regulation 2024/1747 nor draft § 17c EnWG-E mandates central national republication: each operator publishes on its own website under BNetzA abuse supervision. Only Saarland's state geoportal consolidates 6 regional DSOs, and commercial GridChecker aggregates 29 operators.

checked_pages.saw: Guidance on § 17 EnWG grid connection rules, flexible connection agreements (FCA) and construction cost contributions (BKZ); no national substation hosting-capacity map or dataset.

Archive of 2015–2022 PDF reports on distribution grid status and note that from NAP 2024 onward BNetzA publishes thematic articles on smard.de and refers to vnbdigital.de; no substation capacity dataset.
Wholesale generation, consumption, market price and congestion-management time series by bidding/control zone; no substation hosting capacity.
Joint platform of 814 electricity DSOs providing operator boundary layers, § 14d EnWG Netzausbaupläne, regional scenarios and outbound portal links, without node-level available connection capacity.

Cabinet draft Netzanschlusspaket (pp. 8, 25, 41) confirming § 17c(1) EnWG-E requires publication on each operator's own website ('auf ihrer jeweiligen Internetseite'), not in a central BNetzA database.

national_registry.note: Germany has no official national registry or unified dataset of available substation connection capacity. MaStR registers generation/storage units and grid operators without substation hosting capacity, VNBdigital links to 814 DSO profiles and Netzausbaupläne, and GovData/Geoportal.de hold no national hosting-capacity layer.

checked_pages.saw: Regulatory explanations of § 17 EnWG and flexible connection agreements; no national substation capacity dataset.
Daily XML bulk export (3.23 GB ZIP) of energy installations and market actors (869 active Stromnetzbetreiber), containing no substation available connection capacity.
GraphQL API and map for 814 electricity DSOs exposing territory WMS, Netzausbaupläne and portal links, but no substation hosting-capacity figures.

checked_pages.organization: ENTSO-E & EU DSO Entity – Capacitypedia Germany
checked_pages.saw: Explicitly notes that Germany has 4 TSOs and >800 DSOs and that hosting-capacity publication depends on each individual system operator.

National open-data catalogue (checked alongside https://www.geoportal.de/); contains municipal XPlanung plans and Berlin § 23c EnWG structural tables, with no nationwide substation hosting-capacity dataset.

if_unstructured.summary: Where a tested DSO publishes no substation capacity map or a TSO omits numerical MW (Amprion, TenneT), look up the responsible DSO via VNBdigital and extract substation expansion deltas (+/- MVA) and bottleneck flags from its biennial § 14d EnWG Netzausbauplan PDF and annual Repartition/Fair-Grid capacity notices, or submit a formal Netzanschlussbegehren.
recipe: Query https://www.vnbdigital.de/gateway/graphql (or the web map) with the target postal code or municipality to identify the local electricity DSO and check whether it operates Hochspannung (84 DSOs) or Mittelspannung (780 DSOs).

Download the DSO's Netzausbauplan 2026 PDF linked from its VNBdigital profile or corporate website, extract tables with pdftotext -layout, and filter rows where 'Betriebsmittel' mentions 'UW' / 'Umspannwerk' / 'Umspanner' to identify existing or forecast substation bottlenecks and planned MVA additions (note: Netzausbaupläne give planned +/- MVA deltas and bottleneck flags, not current free hosting capacity).

Check the DSO's Netzanschluss section for annual Repartition/Zuteilungsverfahren PDFs to verify whether network-wide MV/HV capacity is capped at 0 MVA, or run a candidate coordinate through its Online-Netzauskunft tool for projects <= 10 MW.
if_unstructured.location_method: Substation names and municipalities in Amprion PDFs and DSO Netzausbaupläne do not always carry coordinates; match named HV/EHV substations against OpenStreetMap power=substation features or regional geoportals (e.g. Geoportal.de / state ALKIS basemaps).
cross_with: OpenStreetMap (power=substation and voltage=* polygons/nodes in Germany, downloadable via Geofabrik https://download.geofabrik.de/europe/germany.html) to geocode named substations lacking coordinates in PDF tables.
Marktstammdatenregister (https://www.marktstammdatenregister.de/MaStR/Datendownload) to aggregate already connected and planned generation/storage capacity in a municipality or grid operator area.
Netzentwicklungsplan Strom (https://www.netzentwicklungsplan.de/) to cross-check planned 220/380 kV TSO substation expansions driving TransnetBW, Amprion and TenneT 2030–2036 horizons.

where_published.name: VNBdigital – Netzausbaupläne nach § 14d EnWG & DSO Portal Directory
where_published.what: Joint platform of 814 German electricity DSOs linking each operator's biennial Netzausbauplan (first statutory cycle due 31 October 2026), regional scenarios, and Netzanschluss portals.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Search by postal code, municipality or operator name via the search bar (backed by POST /gateway/graphql vnb_search and vnb_vnb queries), then open the 'Netzausbauplan' and 'Netzanschluss' cards on the operator profile.

example_document.what_it_gives: Tabular measure list (p. 1 ff.) with columns 'Maßnahme', 'Betriebsmittel', 'Änderung der Übertragungskapazität [+/- MVA]', congestion flags ('bestehenden Engpass zu beheben?', 'prognostizierten Engpass vorzubeugen?') and target dates — e.g. Lfd. Nr. 5 'Erweiterung zum 110 kV Ringschluss', HS-Kabel, '+100' MVA, Inbetriebnahme '12/2029', 'konkrete Planung'.

where_published.how_to_search_inside: On the local DSO's website under 'Netzanschluss' -> 'Mittel-/Hochspannung', open 'Zuteilungsverfahren', 'Repartierungsverfahren', 'Punkteverfahren' or 'Fair Grid' and download the current year's capacity determination PDF.

example_document.what_it_gives: Page 1 ('Ergebnis der Kapazitätsermittlung 2026', Stand August 2026): 'dass für das Jahr 2026 keine unmittelbar verfügbaren freien Netzanschlusskapazitäten im Stromnetz für Leistungsanfragen mit größer als 3,5 MVA zur Vergabe bereitstehen', with next publication due '01.09.2027'.
